# TravelSkills.io

> The first open-source library of Claude Agent Skills for travel and tourism
> professionals. Each skill is built from how the work is really done — field
> interviews, trade sources, and before/after examples — not from generic web
> data. One skill per profession, each targeting a single job.

## Roles and skills

- **Travel Agent** (`claude-travel-agent-skill`): sales, objection handling, dispute resolution, legal obligations.
- **Travel Planner** (`travel-planner-skill`): tailor-made trips, high-end client relationships, itinerary storytelling, pricing rationale.
- **Stay Advisor** (`tourism-stay-advisor`): visitor welcome, local guidance, deep local knowledge, handling lost or unhappy travelers.
- **Tour Operator** (`tour-operator-skill`): product copy, supplier negotiation, B2B communication, pre-departure documents.

## How the skills are built

The library starts from real practice, not the web: interviews, podcasts, trade
articles, and what practitioners say about their day-to-day. Each skill turns
that into before/after examples (one version that sounds generic, one that
sounds right) so an assistant learns by example rather than from abstract rules.
Every example is checked against how travelers actually talk in forums, reviews,
and online communities.

## Status

- First skills: Fall 2026.
- License: MIT. Open to contributions from industry professionals.
- Built and maintained by Nicolas François.
